answer: A newcomer pours one vial of nebula ink into a named mill-race, and the plume's ripple must cross the marked sluice gate within ten seconds of the flow table's time. A plume that arrives late, or never shows, voids the claim and burns a 500 POA bond, barring re-entry six epochs. Each release costs a $95 ink fee plus a $55 gate fee, so 100 fakes need 100 releases at $15,000 and 50,000 POA in bonds, while honest tracers map real currents.
